name: Captain
blurb: Hockey captain: slap shots that knock you back, body checks that send you flying. Ultimate: One-Timer.

sfx.shoot: sharp crack of a hockey stick slapping a puck
sfx.body_hit: heavy body check thud into the boards
sfx.ultimate: huge slap shot crack with a crowd roar

art.floor: smooth pale blue-white ice rink surface with faint skate scratches, a uniform repeating texture with no lines and no objects
art.body: a chibi ice hockey player, full body, front view, crouched in a ready stance: white hockey helmet with a clear visor, bright yellow and white jersey with a big black letter C on the chest, black gloves, yellow shin pads, black ice skates
weapons: a hockey stick lying horizontally pointing right: long white shaft with black tape grip on the left, a black curved blade at the right end

projectiles.puck: a black rubber hockey puck, round and flat with a grey rim, seen from slightly above

art.ultimate_icon: a hockey stick slapping a black puck with bold motion lines
art.ult_circle: a hockey faceoff circle on ice: a red ring with red hash marks and a blue center dot
art.ult_aura: a burst of white ice spray and frost shards flying upward like skates stopping hard
art.hit_fx: a spray of white ice shavings and snow chunks
